visual.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG printout with a four-row layout and a lead II rhythm strip.
visual.detailed_description: Twelve-lead ECG printout on pink millimetre grid paper in a four-row layout: three rows of four lead columns labelled I, aVR, V1, V4; II, aVL, V2, V5; III, aVF, V3, V6, plus a bottom continuous lead II rhythm strip. Calibration square pulses with the printed text 10mm/mV at the top right and at the right end of each row; no paper speed, filter setting, name, date or header text is printed. In V1 to V3 the complexes are predominantly downward deflections of large amplitude (deepest in V2); V4 and V5 show tall upright complexes and V6 shows upright complexes of smaller amplitude. The baseline of the limb leads and the rhythm strip is irregular and wavy. No printed numeric measurements (rate, intervals, axes) are present. ST-segment, Q-wave and interval details cannot be reliably read at this resolution and are not described.
